integrity: The all-sample-size proof derives mixed U-statistic moments from exact uniform integrals and counts identical and one-overlap kernel pairs. The packaged checker recomputes those integrals with exact rational polynomial arithmetic and is supplementary to the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume iid sampling from a uniform distribution on a nondegenerate interval.
The proportional first-order Hoeffding projections are specific to the uniform law and do not hold for general parent distributions.
Older unindexed Gini-mean-difference or U-statistic literature may contain an equivalent mixed-moment identity.
title: Exact uniform-sample coupling of Gini mean difference and variance
